why_people_search.claim: People search for 피지컬 AI to learn its definition and meaning.
People search for learning resources such as 교육, 공부, 논문.
People search for investment‑related information like 관련주, 대장주, ETF.
People search for outlook and future trends such as 전망, 메가 트렌드.
People search for product information including 로봇, 가격.
People search for company and startup information.
People search for job postings and recruitment details.
Many searches fall into an ‘other’ category, covering queries like 기술, 글로벌 얼라이언스, 뉴스.

what_is_happening.claim: News volume about 피지컬 AI surged, with 90 articles today versus a 41.5‑day average, indicating strong momentum.
KAIST announced it will host 'Physical AI KOREA 2026' on October 13, 2026, where it will unveil a vision and strategy for physical AI.
The Physical AI Challenge 2026 was held in Daegu on October 11, 2026, with 147 teams nationwide and Kyungbuk University’s Yard-X team winning the grand prize.
Incheon city began construction of a physical AI verification center, slated for completion in April of the following year.
Media coverage linked Chairman Jung Eui‑seon’s 6‑year anniversary to accelerating the physical AI transition at Hyundai Motor Group.
Hyundai Motor Group announced it will expand investments beyond mobility into physical AI.
Local governments such as Iksan and Jeonbuk are pushing physical AI industry development through industry‑academia‑research cooperation.
Articles highlight that physical AI is seen as a platform covering manufacturing, medical, logistics, etc.
Some reports note gaps in core infrastructure such as factory‑side AIDC for physical AI.

outlook.claim: The upcoming Physical AI KOREA 2026 event on October 13, 2026 is likely to disseminate the national vision and strategy, prompting further industry and government initiatives.
outlook.basis: scheduled event announced in multiple news items

outlook.claim: Completion of Incheon’s physical AI verification center in April next year is expected to provide a test‑bed that will accelerate local adoption and R&D.
Continued announcements from Hyundai Motor Group and related affiliates suggest increasing investment in physical AI solutions over the coming months.

caveats.claim: The analysis relies on Korean‑language news and search data, which may not reflect global trends.
Short‑term spikes in article counts may be driven by event‑centric reporting and may not indicate sustained interest.
Search intent shares show a large ‘other’ category, indicating many queries are not captured by predefined categories, limiting precise interpretation.
